qa_rubric.description: Rex (left) must keep a broad heavy snout and smooth back without a sail; Spino (right) must keep a towering crimson-streaked dorsal sail and long narrow crocodilian snout.
In two-shots, Rex remains on the left side facing right and Spino remains on the right side facing left (180-degree rule).
Water splashes, rain, lightning reflections, and wood splinters move with realistic 3D physics without freezing mid-clip.

beats.purpose: Hook & Standoff: Spinosaurus erupts from the storm swamp and T. rex answers with a shockwave roar
First Clash: Full-speed swamp collision and Spinosaurus forelimb claw slash
Escalation & Counter: Spinosaurus shatters a burning cypress trunk; T. rex ducks and clamps Spinosaurus's neck
Climax & Finisher: T. rex slams Spinosaurus into a massive 3D water geyser and roars in victory
